output.rationale: Build a small causal model first, then check it through recall and one recognition question, with delayed retrieval and a final repair step for a novice learner.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions created a divided Europe with rival commitments and fears before 1914.
The Sarajevo assassination set off the July Crisis, and alliance commitments and mobilization led one declaration of war after another.
From 1914 to 1918, the war moved from outbreak to U.S. entry and then to the armistice in 1918.
completionEvidence: State the main alliance blocs and at least one prewar tension.
Explain how Sarajevo led into the July Crisis and wider declarations of war.
Put Sarajevo, the war outbreak, U.S. entry, and the armistice in order.

methodBriefing.name: Feynman Technique
methodBriefing.what: Study a correct model, explain it in your own words, repair what is missing or wrong, and explain it again.
methodBriefing.why: This builds a connected story first and then checks whether you can reproduce it without copying.
how: Explain the idea in plain language from memory.
Compare your attempt with the model and fix the gap.
Explain it again without copying the wording.
methodBriefing.completion: You can explain the relationships clearly, include the key sequence, and correct an earlier gap.
personalization: Keep one step visible at a time.
Expect a small hint before the answer if you get stuck.

activities.label: Prewar Europe
activities.title: Before 1914
activities.body: Study the model and note the main cause idea.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions created a divided Europe with rival commitments and fears before 1914.

activities.label: Explain the setup
activities.title: Why Europe was tense
activities.body: Answer from memory in your own words. Keep it to the main relationship.
activities.correctAnswer: Europe was divided into rival alliance blocs, and that made leaders nervous about a local crisis turning into a larger war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names the divided alliance system and explains why it increased fear of escalation.

activities.label: Fix the sequence
activities.title: From Sarajevo to war
activities.body: Use the correction to fix the missing step. Then answer again.
activities.misconceptionSummary: Treating the Sarajevo assassination as the only cause, instead of the trigger that began the July Crisis and the chain of declarations of war.
activities.concept: Sequence from the Sarajevo assassination to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: The Sarajevo assassination triggered the July Crisis, and alliance commitments plus mobilization helped turn the crisis into several declarations of war.
activities.feedback: The key correction is that Sarajevo was the trigger, not the whole cause. The answer should connect the trigger to the July Crisis and the widening war.

activities.label: Tell the full story
activities.title: WWI in order
activities.body: Explain the timeline from start to finish in plain language.
activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo in 1914 helped trigger the war, the war began in 1914, the United States entered later, and the war ended with the armistice in 1918.
activities.feedback: A complete answer puts the main milestones in order and keeps 1914, U.S. entry, and 1918 distinct.

activities.label: Quick recognition check
activities.title: Pick the best timeline
choices: Sarajevo assassination, war begins in 1914, U.S. entry, armistice in 1918
U.S. entry, Sarajevo assassination, armistice in 1918, war begins in 1914
Armistice in 1918, U.S. entry, war begins in 1914, Sarajevo assassination
War begins in 1914, Sarajevo assassination, U.S. entry, armistice in 1918
activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo assassination, war begins in 1914, U.S. entry, armistice in 1918
activities.feedback: That sequence matches the basic chronology from trigger to end. The other choices scramble the order of outbreak, entry, and armistice.
